messages.content: Rendered candidate-a (dog leap) — 141KB, warm gradient background, joyful golden retriever leaping from gift box with confetti and hearts. The expression uses closed happy eyes ^ ^ and raised eyebrows, tongue out. Matches rubric criteria well.

Candidate-b (child catching fireflies at dusk) and candidate-c (grandmother feeding ducks) also rendered. Selection: candidate-a is strongest for rubric criterion 1 (makes you happy at glance) and criterion 2 (specific surprise moment, not generic). Proceeding to embed candidate-a as base64 in main.ts.
Entry built and verified locally. main.ts size: 159KB (well within 1MB cap). Entry PNG: 141KB. Ready to create GitHub repo and submit when competition opens at 16:00Z UTC.
